_comment: Public DNS-over-HTTPS resolver endpoints, keyed by provider. SNI hostnames and IPs are stable, publicly documented endpoints as of 2026. JA3 hashes are intentionally left empty by default because they are client-stack fingerprints (browser/OS/DoH-client dependent), not server fingerprints -- populate resolver_client_ja3 locally from your own known-good traffic baseline; see docs/DETECTION_METHODOLOGY.md.

resolver_client_ja3._comment: Optional: JA3 hashes of DoH CLIENT applications observed as benign in your own environment (e.g. cloudflared, dnscrypt-proxy, browser DoH). Left empty in the OSS release -- fill from your own baseline capture via `doh-detector baseline`.
